scope: Read-only installed metadata/source/API audit. This is not a clean-geometry or runtime qualification.
method_admission_reason: A controlled MeshLib surface-remesh route is plausible, but exact original patch/junction/sheet input correspondence has not been established. Remeshing remains blocked; one separately source-reviewed constructor-only roundtrip per patch can test the input-admission contract without generating a target.

sole_detailed_method.operation: Splits long edges and eliminates short edges, with flip/relax controls; no voxel solidification required.

API_evidence.finding: RemeshSettings exposes frozenBoundary, notFlippable, preCollapse veto, region, maximum edge splits and progress callback. notFlippable edges cannot be flipped/collapsed; incident vertices are excluded from relaxation. These are real controls for open-surface/feature protection, not proof of an actual target quality result.
meshFromFacesVerts(faces, verts, settings, duplicateNonManifoldVertices=True) has an explicit false option to disable default non-manifold vertex duplication.
Mesh.fromTriangles is the nonduplicating triangle-ID constructor; the separate duplicating variant resolves non-manifold vertices by duplication and can choose among possible triangle continuations.

BuildSettings exposes allowNonManifoldEdge, an input/output face region whose output records faces failed to add, and skippedFaceCount. Permitting non-manifold edges does not document original source-sheet pairing.
Triangle/topology construction can leave triangles unadded. The duplicating route modifies triangulation and chooses continuations; it is not an established semantic leaf/sheet partition.

Final relaxation may deviate from the original surface. projectOnOriginalMesh applies to subdivision-created vertices before smoothing and explicitly does not cover moved vertices at other processing stages. This limitation alone is not a method blocker: independent point-to-triangle/feature checks can reject drift.
remesh is declared as splitting long and eliminating short edges; no installed native C++ implementation was found in the inspected meshlib and meshlib_core.libs wheel directories.

input_admission_required_before_any_reme: Authenticate exact original reference face/vertex/source identities, boundaries and source sheet/junction relationships.
Use an explicitly nonduplicating constructor path; do not invoke position welding or the automatic continuation/duplication route.

Establish zero skipped faces plus exact oriented source triangle IDs/multiplicity and positions through the constructed topology, or stop. Merely setting allowNonManifoldEdge does not establish that condition.
Establish how original junctions and distinct sheets map to internal topology; do not treat arbitrary input-order pairing or duplicate resolution as a trustworthy semantic partition.
Only if the complete input/protection/correspondence contract is independently admitted, freeze one explicit remesh configuration and one candidate per admitted patch. This audit performs none.
original_field_semantics: The accepted CPU flexible-dual-grid converter interprets7 geometry channels as3 sigmoid-derived dual offsets,3 sign-thresholded intersection flags and a softplus split weight. These are not a supplied signed-distance field.

The installed sparse-structure pipeline thresholds decoder(z_s)>0 and pools/resizes the resulting coarse mask. This establishes occupancy/structure-selection semantics, not a validated fine-resolution inside/outside oracle for leaves, gaps or separate sheets.
Installed Open3D compute_occupancy/compute_signed_distance documentation assumes watertight, nonintersecting meshes. Applying that assumption blindly to the open/non-manifold source is not admitted.
Absence of an established SDF is not an impossibility proof for controlled direct-surface methods.
limits: No actual patch arrays, topology roundtrip, geometry distances or resource peaks were measured by this audit.
Metadata/API stubs and native binary hashes establish installed identity and declarations, not binary runtime behavior or a process-wide memory bound.
Only the named known Windows environment and relevant installed declarations were inspected; this is not a global claim that no possible method exists.
Phase1 is not fully admitted at this point because source-input correspondence remains unresolved, not because a geometry-quality guarantee is required before candidates.
constructor_only_API_admission: GO for independent review of one bounded no-duplication constructor roundtrip per authenticated patch; not a GO for actual source execution or remeshing.

constructor_only_settings.region: FaceBitSet(original_face_count,True): output failed source face IDs
constructor_only_settings.triangle_readback: topology.getTriVerts(mr.FaceId(row)), VertId.get(); compare each original face ID with only recorded cyclic corner rotation allowed
constructor_only_settings.valid_ID_readback: getValidFaces/getValidVerts -> getNumpyBitSet -> exact dense original ID sets

implementation_requirement: No heavy/native numerical module imports before owned binary GO. Import only meshlib.mrmeshpy and meshlib.mrmeshnumpy; reject observed mrcudapy/mrviewerpy/torch/bpy Python modules. Preserve heap-copy input mutation checks and complete per-patch error evidence; stop that patch on any failure, with no alternate constructor.
